name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Every clock that is overdue or due in the next seven days, worst first. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: The law: overdue or due this week
sections.note: HDC Code of Rights Right 10 (New Zealand complaints) and the Victorian statutory duty of candour. Sources in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select ref, service, obligation, due_on, standing, days_over, rule from v_obligation_status where kind = 'law' and standing in ('overdue', 'due soon') order by due_on

sections.title: National policy: overdue or due this week
sections.sql: select ref, service, obligation, due_on, standing, days_over, rule from v_obligation_status where kind = 'policy' and standing in ('overdue', 'due soon') order by due_on

sections.title: House rules: overdue or due this week
sections.sql: select ref, service, obligation, due_on, standing, days_over from v_obligation_status where kind = 'house' and standing in ('overdue', 'due soon') order by due_on

name: incidents
title: Open incidents
subtitle: Everything not closed, with its rating, its review and who owns it.

sections.title: Severity 1 and 2, and sentinel events
sections.sql: select i.ref, i.service, i.category, i.harm, i.rating, i.sentinel_category as sentinel, i.manager, r.method as review, r.due_on as review_due, i.days_open from v_incidents i left join reviews r on r.incident_id = i.id where i.status <> 'closed' and (i.severity <= 2 or i.sentinel_category is not null) order by i.severity, i.reported_at

sections.title: Everything else open
sections.sql: select ref, service, unit, category, harm, rating, manager, days_open from v_incidents where status <> 'closed' and coalesce(severity, 9) > 2 and sentinel_category is null order by reported_at

name: feedback
title: Complaints and compliments
subtitle: Where every complaint sits on its clock.

sections.title: Open complaints
sections.sql: select ref, service, received_on, from_name, category, stage, working_days_open, handled_by from v_complaints where kind = 'complaint' and stage <> 'closed' order by received_on

sections.title: Compliments and suggestions, last 60 days
sections.sql: select ref, service, kind, received_on, about from v_complaints where kind <> 'complaint' and received_on > current_date - 60 order by received_on desc

sections.title: Open risks, highest first
sections.sql: select ref, service, title, likelihood, consequence, score, level, owner, review_due, open_actions from v_risks where status = 'open' order by score desc

sections.title: Actions overdue
sections.sql: select ref, from_ref, description, owner, due_on from v_actions where standing = 'overdue' order by due_on
